term.value: Initial term: 20 Lease Years from the Rent Commencement Date (2/23/2000) → expired 12/31/2020. Four 5-year options; first two exercised, so the lease currently runs through 12/31/2030.

percentageRent.value: 1% of Gross Sales above the Breakpoint (Breakpoint = 100× the annual Minimum Rent), reduced by Tenant's Pro-Rata Share of CAM + Taxes. Paid annually within 120 days of Lease-Year end.

exclusives.description: Food exclusive: no other store/department in the center for the sale of food, groceries, fruit, produce, dairy, vegetables, bakery, meats, or deli. Carve-outs: (a) incidental bakery up to 30% of an occupant's sales; (b) 'Retail H' while the 60-year Walgreens lease is in effect.

modifications.change: Waived to permit a Crumbl Cookies (~2,000 SF) to sell cookies + ancillary ice cream

exclusives.description: Restaurant exclusive: no restaurant within 250 ft of the Building (Outlot A / Shops exceptions)
Liquor-store exclusive: no off-premises liquor store (Walgreens 'Retail H' exception)
Pharmacy exclusive: no drug store / pharmacy (Walgreens 'Retail H' exception)

goDark.value: Permitted — NOT a default. The Premises 'Go Dark' after 365 consecutive days with no business (excluding casualty/repair/remodel/force majeure). Landlord's ONLY remedy: within 365 days, notice to terminate unless reopened within 180 days; if it terminates, Landlord must PAY Tenant the unamortized cost of leasehold improvements/FF&E (prorated by remaining term). Miss the 365-day window and the termination right lapses (revives on the next dark).

assignment.value: Tenant may assign or sublet WITHOUT Landlord consent (≤ 2 units; a non-supermarket assignee may not violate an existing >20,000 SF occupant's exclusive). Landlord RECAPTURE applies only if the whole Premises is assigned/subleased to a 'Nonsupermarket Operator' — Landlord then has a 30-day election to terminate. §18(c): no option exercise is effective unless signed by SUPERVALU Holdings, Inc.; no assignment releases Tenant or any guarantor.

camTax.value: Tenant pays Pro-Rata Share of CAM and Taxes. CAM = direct out-of-pocket only, with capped categories and broad exclusions; arm's-length contracts terminable on 30 days; competitive bids every 2 years for sweeping/snow/landscaping; Tenant audit rights. Taxes = Pro-Rata Share of general real estate taxes + special-assessment installments.

defaultTerms.value: Monetary default: 10 business days after Landlord's notice. Non-monetary: 30 days after notice (extended if not reasonably curable and Tenant is diligently curing). No implied obligations — Tenant is only in default for an uncured breach of an express provision.

flags.issue: Option exercises may require SUPERVALU Holdings' signature (§18(c))
flags.detail: §18(c) says no extension-option exercise is effective unless signed by SUPERVALU Holdings, Inc. The 2019 exercise letter only cc'd Supervalu and the 2025 exercise was signed by Niles Grand/Svigos. Confirm Supervalu countersigned both, or the exercises could be challengeable.

flags.issue: Assignment-embedded $25M net-worth test on option exercises
flags.detail: The 2007 and 2008 assignment instruments bar the assignee from exercising any option, while Supervalu remains contingently liable, unless it shows >$25M tangible net worth (audited/certified) and exercises within 90 days of the deadline. Confirm this was satisfied for the 2019 and 2025 exercises.

flags.issue: Current force of the SUPERVALU Inc. guaranty is uncertain
flags.detail: The Supervalu corporate guaranty turned on Supervalu remaining in the tenant chain; after the 2006 Cerberus sale its continuing force should be verified. The Kang (2007) and Svigos (2008) personal guaranties remain the live credit support.

narrative: Fresh Farms International Market (tenant of record Niles Grand LLC) anchors Pointe Plaza in Niles, IL under a 2/11/1999 Shopping Center Lease originally signed by SUPERVALU Holdings (Cub Foods) and guaranteed by SUPERVALU Inc. The lease passed through three assignments — to Hawk Operations/Cerberus (2006), MS-Grand Niles/Kang (2007), and Niles Grand LLC/Svigos (2008) — each adding a guaranty layer. 58,000 SF; 20-year initial term from a 2/23/2000 rent commencement, with four 5-year options (first two exercised, running the lease through 12/31/2030 at $841,000/yr). The tenant holds strong protections: a broad food/grocery/dairy/bakery exclusive (§9.3, narrowed by a 2022 Crumbl waiver), a tenant-favorable right to go dark with the landlord's only remedy being termination plus a buy-out of unamortized improvements, and a no-consent assignment right with landlord recapture only if the box stops being a supermarket. Watch items: §18(c) requires SUPERVALU Holdings to sign option exercises, and the assignment documents impose a $25M net-worth test — both should be confirmed for the 2019/2025 exercises.
